api: Claude API with computer use beta tool.
cons: Irreversible actions require explicit human approval policy
Higher token cost due to vision
Less reliable on novel or visually complex interfaces
name: Computer Use (Anthropic)
pros: Enables automation of any GUI-based workflow
Same model quality as Claude across all tasks
No per-workflow programming for novel interfaces
files: Operates on whatever the screen contains. No direct file access independent of the applications it opens.
value: Anthropic's computer use capability allows Claude to operate a computer: clicking, typing, reading screens, and navigating interfaces. It is the underlying capability for agentic desktop automation rather than a finished product.
engine: Claude's models with tool use for mouse, keyboard, and screen-capture actions.
latency: Slower than API calls because each action requires a screen observation and decision.

pricing.model: Pay per token, higher than standard Claude due to vision tokens
pricing.includes: Computer use tool calls within the Claude API

quality: Capable for well-defined workflows. Less reliable on novel interfaces or tasks requiring complex visual inference.
tagline: The capability that lets Claude control a computer, not just answer questions about one.
use_cases: Automating multi-step workflows that require interacting with GUIs rather than APIs
Operating software that has no API or programmatic interface
Building agentic tools that require desktop interaction as a primitive
integrations: Containerized desktop environments for safer deployment
governance_note: An AI that can operate a computer is an AI that can take irreversible actions: send emails, execute trades, delete files, commit code, submit forms. The standard agentic governance requirements are at their most critical here. Minimum necessary permissions for the session, explicit human approval before any irreversible action, and a clear task scope are not optional design choices. The blast radius of a mistaken action on an unrestricted desktop is the entire desktop.
training_optout: Anthropic's commercial API terms apply. Screenshots are processed as images within the same terms.
